Security / authentication failure before AS security
Msg4 contention resolution failure — UE HARQ-ACK not received (K1 / PUCCH timing)
RRC Setup PDSCH HARQ retx exhausted (RV 0→2→3→1) — CRC fail on setup TB
Wrong dl-DataToUL-ACK / K1 index vs active BWP SCS or TDD pattern
PRACH/Msg3 failure before RRC Setup Request reaches gNB

Compare dl-DataToUL-ACK table in SIB1/RRCSetup with DCI K1 row index (TS 38.213 §9.2.3)
